scope: Independent parked ATC exact external checks at XYZ endpoints plus conservative per-motion-part XYZ union boxes. Positive union-box hits are candidates, not by themselves confirmed collisions.

continuous_union_candidate_proofs.method: Recursive covering of the complete fixed solid, expanded by the negative independent translation box; exact reference-solid distance. No path sampling. Empty-volume numerical threshold1e-7mm3; required proven separation0.01mm.
